name: speak-reader
title: Speak Reader
description: Read any text aloud with natural Microsoft Edge voices in a floating glass reader with word highlighting and Markdown support. Free, no API key.
author: ethanlong

commands.name: speak-selected-text
commands.title: Speak Selected Text
commands.subtitle: Speak Reader
commands.description: Read the selected text aloud. Run again while reading to stop.

commands.name: speak-clipboard
commands.title: Speak Clipboard
commands.subtitle: Speak Reader
commands.description: Read the text on your clipboard aloud.

commands.name: stop-speaking
commands.title: Stop Speaking
commands.subtitle: Speak Reader
commands.description: Close the reader and stop speaking.

preferences.name: voice
preferences.title: Voice
preferences.description: The voice to read with. "Last Used" follows whatever you last picked in the reader's ⋯ menu.

preferences.name: tableHeaders
preferences.title: Tables
preferences.label: Read column names with every cell
preferences.description: On: each cell is read as "Column: value". Off: column names are read once at the start of a table, then each cell is read with a short pause, like a full stop.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
